note: Real bus reports (archived raw polls) for core/offroute.js; inputs from experiments/routeknower/E27-scripts/make_golden.py, expect = web/js/core/offroute.js offRouteStep chained poll by poll (nowS = feedTs = the poll's header time, the case's alerts, the corridors), computed in headless Edge. The iOS Kit OffRouteTests replays the same file.
format: cases[i] = {name, alerts: [{id, header, description, routes: [Passio route ids], start, end}], polls: [{h, v: [[veh, route_id, lat, lon, report time]]}], expect: [[hidden vehicle ids] per poll]}; shapes / service / routes = the Nov 1 2026 timetable; corridors = web/data/corridors.json (E27c)

corridors.note: The streets each route's buses really drive where its drawn line (shapes.json) is off (RouteKnower E27c, experiments/routeknower/E27-scripts/corridor.py --write): centers of 25 m cells driven in service on at least two thirds of the route's days by at least 5% of its laps, 80 to 400 m from the drawn line. core/offroute.js measures a bus's distance to the line or these points; a route is used only while its drawn line still matches `shape` (points, meters) and before valid_until; a route not listed keeps the E27b rule (250 m for 45 s).

alerts.description: The North route will run every 30 minutes throughout the evening. -University Shuttle System

Due to a construction vehicle blocking the area at 59th Street and Ellis Avenue, the shuttles will be rerouted as follows: Midway to Cottage Grove (dropping passengers off on the Midway for Goldblatts) Cottage Grove to 59th Street (eastbound) 59th Street to Maryland Avenue Maryland Avenue, then back to the regular route Once the area becomes accessible, we will notify everyone and resume normal routing.
